title: invoice-contract-journal
content:
Invoice + Contract scratchpad — daily log

2026-03-09 (created) / last touched 2026-03-12
Quick purpose: running personal checklist for vendor invoices, contract redline notes, and renewal triggers. Not a formal doc — rough TODOs and things to follow up on.

TODAY'S CONTEXT:
- Main priorities: clear outstanding invoices >30 days, finish redlines for ZenoCloud SOW, set calendar reminders for auto-renewal windows.
- Triage: Legal ops asked for a short writeup on two vendor renewals (ZenoCloud, Metricly) by EOD Fri.

ONGOING TODOs (prioritized)
[ ] INV-2026-011 (ZenoCloud) — confirm PO/receipt and push payment confirmation to AP.
    - AP contacting vendor for updated W-9 (cc: Aisha).
    - Amount: $18,720. Quick check: contract shows milestone-based payments; bookkeeping shows full invoice submitted. Flag if mismatch.
[ ] Redline ZenoCloud SOW (v3) — items below. Aim to send to Marco by 2026-03-13.
    - Liability cap: request reduction from unlimited to 2x fees. Note: mention precedence from Acme contract (see LEGAL-298).
    - Data handling clause: add language to require encryption at rest for customer data and quarterly penetration test attestation.
    - Auto-renewal: change default to explicit renewal (opt-in) or add 60-day written notice for renewal.
    - Termination for convenience: add 30-day termination with prorated refund.
[ ] Metricly renewal reminder — check contract term (ends 2026-05-30). Set calendar reminder 90 / 30 / 7 days.
[ ] Update renewal tracker sheet with correct billing contact for ZenoCloud (they gave new AP name in email).
[ ] Draft vendor email templates: payment confirmation, missing-docs reminder, renewal negotiation intro.

QUICK NOTES / SCRATCHES
- INV-2026-011 timeline: invoice dated 2026-02-14, due 2026-03-16 per net30? But AP put it as net45 accidentally. Check original SOW for payment terms.
- If AP pays early, ask for discount? Not standard — check with Finance. Tag: finance-discuss.
- Marco suggested adding SLA credits language; follow up example clause from internal library. Confluence: linked_artifacts[0].

EMAILS / SLACK TO SEND (short templates)
- To Zeno AP: "Hi — confirming we received invoice INV-2026-011. Can you re-send W-9 to ap@redwood.ai and confirm bank details? We have the invoice queued for payment once docs received."
- To Zeno PM (contract): "Attaching redline; two quick asks: data encryption attestation and revise auto-renewal notice. Can we get a call next Tue?"

LIGHTBOOKKEEPING / NUMBERS
- Outstanding (quick glance):
    * INV-2026-009 (Metricly) $4,200 — paid 2026-03-01 (mark reconciled) [x]
    * INV-2026-010 (InfraTools) $12,450 — pending PO (AP flagged) [ ]
    * INV-2026-011 (ZenoCloud) $18,720 — waiting W-9 [ ]
- Quick totals: outstanding flagged = $31,170. Put on next AM agenda with AP.

REDLINE NOTES (freeform)
- Clause 4.2 (IP): tighten to ensure ML models trained on customer data are owned by customer. Add "excluding anonymized aggregate metrics" carve-out.
- Clause 7 (confidentiality): define "confidential" with explicit examples; set 2-year return/destroy window after termination.
- Clause 12 (indemnity): narrow scope to third-party claims arising from vendor negligence; remove broad mutual indemnity where possible.

QUESTIONS / TO-ASK
- Do we have a precedent for 60-day auto-renewal notice? Marco — what did we do for Acme? (ping LEGAL-298)
- Finance: acceptable to pay partial milestone if doc mismatch? Need AP guidance.
- If vendor resists encryption attestation, what compromise? E.g., SOC2 Type II + yearly pentest report.

NEXT STEPS (this week)
1) 2026-03-12: Send first-pass redline to Marco (in progress).
2) 2026-03-12: Ping AP re: W-9 and PO discrepancy for INV-2026-011.
3) 2026-03-13: Draft two short vendor templates and save in Drive /legal-ops/templates.
4) 2026-03-14: Add calendar reminders for Metricly renewal and set task for outreach 90 days prior.

NOTES TO SELF
- Keep this doc as temporary scratchpad; extract final action items into Jira tickets once confirmed.
- Copy key redline bullets into shared review doc before sending to vendor.
- Remember to CC finance@redwood.ai when confirming payments.

END.
